ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image shows a pie chart of the main distribution of desertified land in China, in which Xinjiang accounts for the largest share, about 40%; Inner Mongolia about 24%; Tibet about 16%; Qinghai about 8%; the figure also marks smaller parts such as Gansu, Ningxia, Shaanxi, Shanxi, Hebei, and Other. From this it can be seen that desertified land is concentrated in the northwestern and northern arid and semi-arid regions, and Gansu also belongs to the northwestern desertification distribution provinces and regions shown in the figure. The question stem asks: the main causes of desertification in Gansu Province include wind-eroded desertification and which type. Gansu is located in the northwestern inland, with an arid climate and strong evaporation; irrigation agricultural areas are prone to groundwater level rise and salt accumulation in the soil surface layer, so the main type parallel with wind-eroded desertification should be soil salinization desertification.
